lines.zh: 我在黑里走，脚下不看路。
lines.en: I walk in the dark without watching the ground.

lines.zh: 每走几步，我的头就歪一下。
lines.en: Every few steps my head lolls to one side.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，在草上留痕。
lines.en: I drag one leg, leaving a trail in the grass.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我才从树后走出来。
lines.en: Only when it is dark do I come out from the trees.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上晃，比人矮。
lines.en: My shadow wobbles on the wall, shorter than a man.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，像忘了怎么走。
lines.en: I shuffle along as if I have forgotten how to walk.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，草叶都发灰。
lines.en: Where I pass, the blades of grass turn grey.

lines.zh: 我绕着火把走，光让我睁不开眼。
lines.en: I circle the torch; the light makes my eyes squeeze shut.

lines.zh: 我把手伸在前面，摸墙找路。
lines.en: I hold my hands out front, feeling along the wall.

lines.zh: 我回过身，又忘了要去哪。
lines.en: I turn around, having forgotten where I was going.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，是赤脚踩出来的。
lines.en: My steps are light; they come from bare feet.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的灯，一直走到黑处。
lines.en: I follow your lantern, right up to where the light ends.

lines.zh: 我站在树荫里，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the shade of a tree, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，像在等谁回答。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, as if waiting for an answer.

lines.zh: 我在听自己的呼吸，太响了。
lines.en: I listen to my own breathing; it is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我抬头看月亮，看了很久。
lines.en: I look up at the moon and keep looking.

lines.zh: 我的指甲缝里塞满了泥。
lines.en: There is dirt packed under my fingernails.

lines.zh: 有只兔子跑过，我没去追。
lines.en: A rabbit runs past, and I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 我试着念自己的名字，念不出。
lines.en: I try to say my own name and cannot manage it.

lines.zh: 远处的村庄有灯，太亮了。
lines.en: Lights burn in the village beyond; they are too bright.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，有点陌生。
lines.en: I look down at my hands; they seem unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我在土里挖了个坑，又填回去。
lines.en: I dig a hole in the soil and fill it back in.

lines.zh: 我的肚子不饿了，这很奇怪。
lines.en: My stomach has stopped hurting, which is strange.

lines.zh: 我数着夜里的虫叫，数到七。
lines.en: I count the insects of the night, up to seven.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴在凉的石头上。
lines.en: I press my face against a cold stone.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑透，那样更好走。
lines.en: I wait for full dark; it is easier to move then.

lines.zh: 我靠着树，慢慢滑坐下去。
lines.en: I lean on a tree and slide down to sit.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出湿的声音。
lines.en: A wet sound comes out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡住眼前的光。
lines.en: I raise a hand against the light.

lines.zh: 树后有菌丝的味道，是我的。
lines.en: Behind the tree is the smell of mycelium: mine.

lines.zh: 你站在光里，我站在这里。
lines.en: You stand in the light; I stand right here.

lines.zh: 你的脸好红，我很久没见过红的了。
lines.en: Your face is so red; I have not seen red in ages.

lines.zh: 我偏头看你，脖子响了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see you, and my neck clicks.

lines.zh: 你还活着，真好，可以一起走。
lines.en: You are still alive — good. We can walk together.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，想说话，只落出孢子。
lines.en: I lift my chin to speak, and only spores fall out.

lines.zh: 你的手臂上有光，是铁还是水？
lines.en: Something shines on your arm — iron, or water?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，那里在动。
lines.en: I stare at your throat, where something moves.

lines.zh: 我认得你，可我说不出为什么。
lines.en: I know you, though I cannot say from where.

lines.zh: 你后退时，我慢慢跟上半步。
lines.en: When you back away, I quietly take half a step.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有东西在转，很亮。
lines.en: Something turns inside your eyes, very bright.

lines.zh: 我抬手想碰你，又放下了。
lines.en: I raise a hand to touch you, then let it drop.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，我只是想看看你。
lines.en: Do not rush off; I only wanted a look at you.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我喉咙里长出来。
lines.en: Mycelium is growing out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀被你砍开了一条口子。
lines.en: You have opened a gash across my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，还是站着。
lines.en: I sway once and remain standing.

lines.zh: 血是绿的，你别害怕。
lines.en: The blood is green; do not be frightened.

lines.zh: 你打得挺准，正中我的肋。
lines.en: That was a good hit, right in my ribs.

lines.zh: 伤口不流血，只流菌丝。
lines.en: The wound does not bleed; it only leaks mycelium.

lines.zh: 我退了，但我会回来。
lines.en: I fall back, but I will return.

lines.zh: 挨打让我想起死的那天。
lines.en: Being hit brings back the day I died.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，手上有绿。
lines.en: I press the wound and my hand comes away green.

lines.zh: 再打我一次，我就更想咬你。
lines.en: Hit me again and I will want to bite you more.

lines.zh: 你手里的面包，味道太熟了。
lines.en: The bread in your hand smells far too familiar.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我忘了该吃什么。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I forget what I am meant to eat.

lines.zh: 你晃晃手，我就跟了过去。
lines.en: You wave your hand, and I follow along.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起某个厨房。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of some kitchen, long ago.

lines.zh: 我伸手去接，手指弯不下来。
lines.en: I reach for it; my fingers will not bend.

lines.zh: 你举着肉，我闻了闻就退了。
lines.en: You hold out meat; I sniff it and step away.

lines.zh: 我不会吃，但我会一直跟着。
lines.en: I will not eat it, but I will keep following.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我蹲下去看。
lines.en: You set it down, and I crouch to look at it.

lines.zh: 饿了很久的人，会记得食物的样子。
lines.en: Someone hungry long enough remembers how food looks.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在动，可嘴里什么都没有。
lines.en: My mouth is working, though there is nothing in it.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我差点倒了。
lines.en: You run into me and I nearly go down.

lines.zh: 我们擦肩，你身上好暖。
lines.en: We brush past; you are so warm.

lines.zh: 我被人撞得退了半步，才站住。
lines.en: A shove knocks me back half a step before I steady.

lines.zh: 别推我，我的骨头很脆。
lines.en: Do not shove me; my bones are brittle.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的脚，我没吭声。
lines.en: You step on my foot, and I say nothing.

lines.zh: 撞到我的肩上，落了一层灰。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and a layer of dust falls.

lines.zh: 我扶住你的手臂，才没摔倒。
lines.en: I grab your arm to keep myself from falling.

lines.zh: 你躲得快，我的手只碰到袖子。
lines.en: You dodge fast; my hand only catches your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你的甲很硬。
lines.en: We collide, and your armour is hard as stone.

lines.zh: 我站不稳，可我还是没让路。
lines.en: I cannot stand steady, and still I do not move aside.

lines.zh: 我们不必说话，碰一下就好。
lines.en: We need no words; one touch will do.

lines.zh: 你的手凉了，正好配我的。
lines.en: Your hand has gone cold — that suits mine.

lines.zh: 我把额头贴上你的额头。
lines.en: I press my forehead against yours.

lines.zh: 等你也倒下，我们就一样了。
lines.en: When you fall too, we will be the same.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我的手指爬到你手上。
lines.en: Mycelium creeps from my fingers onto your hand.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，等着天黑。
lines.en: We sit side by side and wait for night.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的呼吸节奏。
lines.en: I have memorised the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 你不会疼的，我保证。
lines.en: You will not feel any pain; I promise that.

lines.zh: 两个人一起走，被找到得更快。
lines.en: Two of us walking together get found sooner.

lines.zh: 天亮了我们就得分开，先坐着。
lines.en: At dawn we must part; for now, sit with me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，握在手里。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and close my hand around it.

lines.zh: 这根木棍，可以当拐杖。
lines.en: This stick will do as a walking cane.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的苹果塞进口袋。
lines.en: I push the fallen apple into my pocket.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚铁片，它很凉。
lines.en: I pick up a scrap of iron; it is cold.

lines.zh: 谁掉的面包？我先收着。
lines.en: Whose bread is this? I will hold on to it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡东西，起来花了很久。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up and take a long time rising.

lines.zh: 我把破布条缠在手上当绷带。
lines.en: I wrap the torn cloth around my hand as a bandage.

lines.zh: 骨头掉在地上，我捡起来看。
lines.en: A bone falls to the ground; I pick it up to look.

lines.zh: 我把种子装进口袋，虽然不吃。
lines.en: I pocket the seeds, though I will not eat them.

lines.zh: 捡东西这件事，我还记得。
lines.en: Picking things up is something I still remember.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You have no fungus on you; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，慢慢地。
lines.en: I have settled on you, slowly.

lines.zh: 黑处的人，总是我先看见。
lines.en: In the dark, I always see people first.

lines.zh: 你在灯下，所以你看不见我。
lines.en: You are under a lamp, so you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 落在最后的那个，菌丝记得。
lines.en: The one lagging behind — my mycelium remembers.

lines.zh: 别回头，那样我会更快。
lines.en: Do not look back; that only makes me faster.

lines.zh: 你的血在跳，隔着三步都听得见。
lines.en: Your blood is pounding; I hear it three steps away.

lines.zh: 我看见你的肩膀在动了。
lines.en: I see your shoulder move.

lines.zh: 目标就是那个还在呼吸的人。
lines.en: The target is the one still breathing.

lines.zh: 你挡在路中间，我只能找你。
lines.en: You are in my way; I have no other choice.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，你不必急。
lines.en: I come closer one step at a time; no need to rush.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，算你离我多远。
lines.en: I tilt my head and work out how far off you are.

lines.zh: 你的盾举得太高，脖子露着。
lines.en: Your shield is too high; your neck is showing.

lines.zh: 我在数你的脚步，一二三。
lines.en: I count your footsteps: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 再退，你就退到树跟前了。
lines.en: Keep backing up and you will reach the tree.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，你已经在我臂长里。
lines.en: I reach out; you are already within arm's length.

lines.zh: 我等着你抬头，好看清你的脸。
lines.en: I wait for you to look up so I can see your face.

lines.zh: 你不跑，我就慢慢来。
lines.en: If you do not run, I will take my time.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，请别介意。
lines.en: My hand is shaking; please pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我得绕开。
lines.en: You smell of iron; I will have to go around it.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，你会跟我一样。
lines.en: When I bite, you will end up like me.

lines.zh: 指甲刮过你的手臂，出血了。
lines.en: My nails rake your arm and draw blood.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，力气不小。
lines.en: I grab your collar with more strength than I look.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在肩上，很准。
lines.en: This bite lands square on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的血是热的，我愣了一下。
lines.en: Your blood is warm; I pause for a moment.

lines.zh: 我推开你，你退了三四步。
lines.en: I shove you back, and you stumble three or four steps.

lines.zh: 我咬住袖子，撕下一块。
lines.en: I bite into your sleeve and tear a piece off.

lines.zh: 菌已经进了你的伤口，别挠。
lines.en: The fungus is in your wound now; do not scratch it.

lines.zh: 你打回来，我退，然后靠得更近。
lines.en: You hit back, I retreat, then press even closer.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，牙齿凑上去。
lines.en: I seize your wrist and bring my teeth up to it.

lines.zh: 我从草里站起来，天刚黑。
lines.en: I stand up out of the grass just as night falls.

lines.zh: 黑暗里有人死过，我就在这了。
lines.en: Someone died here in the dark; now I am here.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，第一件事是找路。
lines.en: I open my eyes, and the first task is to find a way.

lines.zh: 这具身体曾经有过名字。
lines.en: This body used to have a name.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，膝盖先弯了一下。
lines.en: As I rise, my knees give way once.

lines.zh: 土很凉，我从里面爬出来。
lines.en: The soil is cold; I crawl up out of it.

lines.zh: 有人把我埋了，我又出来了。
lines.en: Someone buried me; I have come out again.

lines.zh: 我记得这片林子，现在它变绿了。
lines.en: I remember this wood; it has turned green now.

lines.zh: 夜里出生的东西，怕光。
lines.en: Things born at night are afraid of light.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的土，慢慢直起腰。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off and straighten up slowly.

lines.zh: 这次醒来，我比上次更饿。
lines.en: Waking this time, I am hungrier than before.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在说话，就朝那边去。
lines.en: I hear voices far off and start walking toward them.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上冒出白烟。
lines.en: The flame catches me, and white smoke rises.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我的手臂折了。
lines.en: Falling, my arm breaks under me.

lines.zh: 水下我喘不上气，我早该喘不上。
lines.en: Underwater I cannot breathe, though I should not need to.

lines.zh: 炸响之后，我的耳朵一直在响。
lines.en: After the blast, my ears keep ringing.

lines.zh: 箭穿过来，把我钉在原地。
lines.en: An arrow comes through and pins me where I stand.

lines.zh: 药水泼上来，我的皮在冒泡。
lines.en: The potion splashes me and my skin starts to bubble.

lines.zh: 我饿，但饿不死，这才难受。
lines.en: I am hungry and cannot starve; that is the worst part.

lines.zh: 雷落在旁边，我的骨头亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lands beside me, lighting up my bones.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连菌丝也追不上我。
lines.en: Falling into the void, even the mycelium cannot follow.
